title: Two possibilities

tutorial.text: The H gate creates two possibilities. Make |+⟩.

hints: H turns |0⟩ into an equal mix of |0⟩ and |1⟩.
why: |+⟩ has equal amplitudes for 0 and 1. Measuring it gives 0 about half the time and 1 about half the time. It is not a hidden coin: a later gate can turn it back into a sure result.
